speaker: announcer
text: We interrupt this program to bring you a special bulletin. Nonimaginaires, the brain fogs, are eating The First Pulse. Five pages are going gray in the dark between stars. Behind the fog is a dead air that swallows stories. The hum underneath it is still listening.

speaker: announcer
text: You are on the ship. The dish is pointed at the first light. The pages are torn. Put them back.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. In the beginning there was no light, no matter, no void. Only the hum.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. The hum was already listening. Then, one day, or one epoch, it answered.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. A dish on the dark side of the ship drank the oldest radio in the sky, and something in it drank back.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. A wave needs no medium. It moves at the speed of light, indifferent to distance, indifferent to time.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. Humanity's breakthroughs are not accidents. They are invitations.

speaker: announcer
text: The first light. The window still remembers a universe that had only a vibration.

speaker: announcer
text: The dish. It was built to listen. The hum had been listening longer.

speaker: announcer
text: The bridge. Consoles, code, and a carrier wave with nobody's name on it.

speaker: announcer
text: The wave. Out here the signal is the weather.

speaker: announcer
text: Stand by. The Hum has fused with a Nonimaginaire. The face is gone. The vibration stayed.

speaker: announcer
text: The First Pulse has its color back. The hum is still there. It is only listening again.

speaker: announcer
text: The next dark is already forgetting the name of its star.

speaker: listener
text: You walked in during a true signal. I am the Listener. The dish heard you before I did.

speaker: listener
text: No face on that fog. The carrier still has a tone. I do not like the tone.

speaker: listener
text: In the beginning there was only the hum. The window is trying to say it again.

speaker: listener
text: The dish is mine. Something older is using it. Do not tune past the first pulse.

speaker: listener
text: Those consoles were invitations. We thought we invented them.

speaker: listener
text: Out past the glass, the wave does not need a ship. We brought one anyway.

speaker: listener
text: That is the Hum with the face washed off. The vibration stayed.

speaker: listener
text: Keeper, if you fall, the dish will keep your frequency a while.

speaker: listener
text: The color is back in the carrier. I will take a quiet sky.

speaker: listener
text: A torn page. The book wants it more than the static does.

speaker: listener
text: The set remembers. The hum remembers longer.

speaker: listener
text: The picture is rolling. That ring is the way back to the cabinet.

speaker: listener
text: A locker. If it hums, it is already open in some other year.

speaker: listener
text: Ground the wave. The rings are only the announcement.

speaker: listener
text: Longer in the legs. Try to look like the signal taught you that.

speaker: listener
text: It is leaning out of its own frequency. So am I. Different reasons.

speaker: pilot
text: Pilot. If the board ticks, I already heard it. Do not touch the carrier marked don't.

speaker: pilot
text: I can hit it. The key has the longer reach. I have the longer grudge.

speaker: pilot
text: That window is the first light. I flew us here on purpose. I am choosing to keep saying that.

speaker: pilot
text: A dish big enough to hear the beginning. The beginning heard us back.

speaker: pilot
text: My chair. My switches. Something else has been flipping them since before the ship had a name.

speaker: pilot
text: No medium out here. Just the wave, and us, and a fog that wants the pages.

speaker: pilot
text: The Hum, and a fog wearing it. I like the rings. I do not like what is inside them.

speaker: pilot
text: Still here. The board is still longer than the problem.

speaker: pilot
text: Color's back in the gauges. I will take that over a medal.

speaker: pilot
text: A page. Don't bend it. I bend everything else.

speaker: pilot
text: Up. The key does the rest.
